intent.statement: Implement the AI Chunking Single-Document Implementation Plan: replace Text Chunking persistence with one strict authoritative chunks_text.json document, remove report/state sidecar reads and writes, preserve runtime-only progress and current-profile resume behavior, update downstream consumers, tests, and documentation, and provide no legacy compatibility beyond Reset Chunking cleanup.

examples: A valid deterministic document round-trips and returns defensive chunk copies.
A bare chunk array or any extra root or chunk field raises the Reset Chunking incompatibility error.
spec_items.statement: The sole persisted Chunking authority is a strictly validated root-object chunks_text.json containing exactly the approved document and chunk fields, with all counts and runtime or provider configuration derived rather than persisted and every legacy shape rejected.
spec_items.threshold: Zero production reads or writes of obsolete Chunking sidecars and zero non-approved persisted fields.

examples: Provider output that fails validation commits no partial chunks.
Runtime progress callbacks remain accurate without progress fields in the document.
spec_items.statement: Each deterministic unit or validated AI window commits one complete atomic Chunking document checkpoint, while cancellation and failure preserve prior commits and completion represents every canonical paragraph with next_paragraph null.

examples: Changing profile or context settings repartitions only remaining paragraphs.
Changing clean_text.txt blocks resume and directs the operator to Reset Chunking.
spec_items.statement: AI Chunking resumes only a source-compatible resumable AI document using its stored strategy and instructions, the currently selected profile and recalculated budget, cumulative usage and fallback state, and a new separate log for the invocation.

examples: An inserted chunk has only the approved minimal chunk fields and empty nullable cleanup provenance.
spec_items.statement: Every successful manual chunk edit, insertion, or deletion atomically preserves the completed document origin and durable audit fields, maintains stable IDs where possible, resequences chunks, sets manual_adjusted true, and leaves workflow-impact details in memory.

examples: An incompatible chunks_text.json cannot be healed or migrated and requires Reset Chunking.
spec_items.statement: Project lifecycle derives Chunking readiness and compact manifest state only from a strict completed non-empty document, opening the page creates no default Chunking artifact, and Reset removes the document, matching logs, obsolete sidecars, and configured downstream artifacts without reading legacy data.

Every canonical downstream reader uses the shared document API, and Text Chunks export derives document-level mode, strategy, and counts while locating separate AI logs without any persisted log path.
spec_items.threshold: All focused downstream-consumer tests and the complete application suite pass with no production legacy Chunking reader.

examples: A cancelled AI document displays resumable state using next_paragraph without presenting persisted current or total progress.
spec_items.statement: The Text Chunking page and controller derive not-started, running, resumable, completed, warned, and manually adjusted states from the authoritative document, resume without re-prompting stored instructions, use the selected profile, and retain existing rerun and reset confirmations.
